title: Gisela Baur VALUEx BRK 2026
description:
Thirty Years of Interviewing Warren Buffett 
The German journalist on what she has learned: his memory, his trick of always asking rather than performing, and his willingness to give things up to make room for what matters.

See the full stream of the event here: https://youtube.com/live/V3V7bqLGP9o
summary: The speaker recounts her thirty-year journey from a German journalist fascinated by Warren Buffett's success to becoming his translator and a close associate, emphasizing that his methods rely on a photographic memory, the ability to build a precious collection of people based on instant trust, and the human factor which cannot be calculated. She argues that Buffett's approach simplifies complex macro predictions by focusing on America's best days ahead and that true success in investing and life comes from curiosity, judging people, and fostering a heartwarming web of trust rather than just financial metrics.
